content: .{@-सिद्ध@} {%a.%} proved or demonstrated wrongly; (in Nyāya) said of a cause (कारण) which is not the true one, but only refers to accidental and remote circumstances (as the ass employed to fetch clay <ab>&c.</ab> in the case of a घट or jar) which do not invariably contribute to the result, see कारण; this अन्यथा˚ is said to be of 3 kinds in <ls>Tarka K.</ls>, but 5 are mentioned in <ls>Bhāṣā P. 19-22</ls>.
